data.gender_notes: Armbrecht is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old German, the name Armbrecht translates to ‘ruler of the strong arms’. The name was commonly given to boys in the Middle Ages, reflecting the value placed on strength and martial prowess during that period. The name Armbrecht carries the meaning “Arms' strong ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Armbrecht usually hope their child will grow to embody arms' strong ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Armbrecht can also serve as a reminder of God's strength and protection. In the biblical sense, having 'strong arms' signifies the ability to carry the burdens of life and face challenges with unwavering faith. This name encourages its bearer to lean on God's strength in times of hardship, trusting in the divine provision and guidance.
